question: An Uber auto covers a distance of 639 km in 71 hours. What is its speed in km/hr?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed (km/hr) = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Speed = 639 ÷ 71

⇒ Speed = 9 km/hr

**∴ Answer = 9 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance = 639 km

Time = 71 hours

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 Distance = 639 km Time = 71 hours 
• 
 Speed = 639 ÷ 71 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed = 639 ÷ 71

⇒ Speed = 9 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9 km/hr (Option 2).**
